notes.title: Design a car for a future Make Way update!
notes.notes:
That’s right, starting today and running until August 29th, we’re looking to you, the community, for some fabulous cars to join the action in Make Way! Design your very own machine to race, jump, and smash your way to victory on Make Way’s ever-changing tracks.  



To enter, join our Discord and post your design in the ‘Community Cars’ channel.



FOUR* community-designed cars will make their way into Make Way. Below are the rules for entering: 



The cars have to be scaled to fit the game, so there may be slight changes from your concept to the final design.

Submit your entry via a post in the “Community Cars” channel in our Discord. Only entries sent in this channel will be considered.

Nothing NSFW or offensive.

No use of generative AI tools or programs is allowed.

The competition closes on 29 August 2025, 12:00 pm BST.

Your car must have wheels.

There can't be any animated parts, such as wings.

Only one entry per person.

Digital and traditionally drawn cars are welcome to be submitted!


Winning entries will be added in a future update; the date for this is TBC. 

The winning designs will be selected by the Ice Beam and Secret Mode teams. Good luck to all entrants! 


*There is a chance we end up using more than four, but that is the current goal.

notes.title: Make Way Hotfix
notes.notes:
Following the 1.3 Patch last month, some of you made us aware of a few issues which we've taken time to investigate.

We've now rolled out a small hotfix which addresses the following issues:

 Ice Drop physics fixed
 Adjustments to keyboard vector to improve keyboard handling and physics
 A null reference check in track piece selection (Assists with preventing desync)
 Game now correctly detects the monitors refresh rate
 Ghosted cars are no longer slower than non-ghosted cars

This should get things back on track for all players. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305080/ab391f161f85ce9beb65fa9ec27e64b85bba31bc.png

Thanks for the continued support. Vroom Vroom!

For more support, updates and to find more players to race with, join the official Make Way Discord

notes.title: Make Way free update to cause even more chaos!
notes.notes:
Get ready to ruin even more friendships! A free update has arrived for Make Way, introducing a wide range of additions and improvements, including a much-requested feature: more racers! 

This update adds the following features:

 6 PLAYERS! Max players increased from 4 to 6.
 FULLY CUSTOMISABLE GAMES! Introducing a new weapon / item toggle menu.
 3 NEW VEHICLES! Including the new ‘Milk Truck’ based on the streamer SMii7Y.
 BATTLE MODE RULES! New pre-set rules to jump straight into the action.
 BULLDOZER! This new item allows players to remove/destroy parts of the track.
 PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS BETWEEN PLATFORMS!
 VARIOUS OTHER BUG FIXES!

[previewyoutube=Y8MkSu28IBM;full][/previewyoutube]
Players can now face off against five of their friends and rivals in local* and fully cross-platform online races, with all six racers battling to pick up track pieces, build something resembling a coherent track, and smash each other into the void as they fight for victory. It's all the chaos of Make Way, pushed to the extreme! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305080/e566682d9b780b52db16de1adf18d77b2fe1ee50.jpg
With six players in the mix, things on the track are bound to get hectic, so why not calm it down a little? Deploy the new Bulldozer track piece to clear away some of the obstacles that your rivals have put down and make yourself a path to victory... or leave space for an even deadlier item. 

Players will also have more choice over how they race, with the Custom race mode being even more customisable than before. Increase the final score limit, change how many fails it takes to trigger a checkpoint skip, and more, to create your own racing heaven (or hell). You can even set which weapons and obstacles show up in the game and adjust the rates at which they appear. Tailor your combinations for a balanced game or turn off all the walls and put shotguns absolutely everywhere. The choice is yours. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305080/23d6e0780911b722b727e6559c12d8145b0cf702.jpg
On top of all that, there are three new vehicles to bash your friends with. Take the kids for a drive in the Crumple Zone, feel like a real racer in the Thunder, or force a daily dose of calcium on your foes in the Milk Truck, modelled after streamer and Make Way lover SMii7Y. 

As if all of that wasn't enough, new trading cards, badges and emotes will be available as part of the update. 
 
So what are you waiting for? Grab your friends and get racing! 

Get all the latest updates and find more players to race in the official Make Way Discord 
 
*Six-player local multiplayer is available on PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S.

notes.title: 1.2 Patch Update makes its way to all platforms
notes.notes:
Hey racers!

The course keeps growing! Make Way officially launches TODAY on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. Alongside the launch, Patch 1.2, which many of the community have already been racing on in a public beta, will be fully rolled out on all platforms.

So, what's in Patch 1.2 you ask? A lot of bug fixes, improvements to cross-platform connectivity, and many other tweaks to improve your racing.  Full patch notes here.

Did we mention that Make Way is fully crossplay between PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X AND PlayStation 4 and 5? 
 
Grab your friends and race today! 
 
Please Note: Players already on the 1.2 Beta branch should now return to the main game branch 
 
Get all the latest updates and find more players in our Discord

notes.title: Make Way Patch 1.2 early opt-in available + 40% off!
notes.notes:
Hi racers, 

Today we're rolling out a huge update on the beta branch, with Patch 1.2 bringing a heap of improvements to online play, alongside some other gameplay tweaks to make for an even smoother racing experience. 

To celebrate, Make Way will be available at a 40% discount for the next seven days! It's the perfect opportunity to grab your friends and create some vehicular mayhem. 

Patch notes are listed below (there are a lot!), but for anyone who hasn't accessed the beta yet, follow these steps: 
 
Right click 'Make Way' in your Steam Library and select 'Properties' 
Select 'Betas' 
In the 'Beta Participation' drop-down select 'patch_1.2' 
The update should now download 

Please note: if you play on the 1.2 patch, you will only be able to play against others on the same patch. This is due to some fundamental changes to how online play works in the new patch, which would cause problems with players on earlier patches on PC or console. 

With that in mind, here's a comprehensive list of everything that's been updated and fixed in this bumper patch: 

GAMEPLAY CHANGES 


 Added ability to use bots in an online match 
 New "client authoritative movement" has been added, making client vehicle / control feel much more responsive when playing online 
 Added a "relay server" fallback option, to help players with connection issues 
 Refactored shortcut logic so anyone attempting to take a shortcut won't be killed when offscreen 
 Added horn timeout to stop players that hold / abuse horn sounds 
 Added "select vehicle colour" option to the vehicle selection screen 
 Added "checkpoint skip" logic, so players move to the next checkpoint if they fail a section three times 
 Add toggle to "hide lobby code" so people streaming the game don't get bombed with random players 
 Doubled the amount of XP when playing a "race mode" race, meaning "classic mode" will unlock faster for new players 
 Added an XP multiplier if there are fewer players, so it feels a bit fairer when playing with just two people 
 Increased machine gun, shotgun, and tesla coil effectiveness 
 Nerfed the shotgun to one bullet 
 Added networked player control on vehicles on the victory screen 


BUG FIXES 


 Fixed client shortcuts always being disabled when playing online (which means in most cases they would never work) 
 Fixed the selected race mode being reset after 3 games when playing online 
 Fixed numerous de-sync issues when track building 
 Fixed duplicate players when host and client are both playing on a LAN with certain routers 
 Fixed track space on special "exit" pieces so players aren't destroyed (and get stuck in a loop) when they are used 
 Fixed forced auto-selecting track pieces when clients are sometimes picking 
 Fixed it so that invites work when launching a game on Steam 
 Fixed some achievements not working on Xbox and Steam 
 Added message pop-up if client can't join match because of a crossplay mismatch 
 Fixed the game trying to load a vehicle texture that was already loaded on the select vehicle screen, making the screen lag 
 Fixed prop spawning so that the trees, and other props, spawn correctly on the Arctic Tundra level 
 Fixed sudden death win order 
 Increased minimum amount of checkpoint time when solo, and checked that all pieces have enough time, so that certain sections should now be possible to complete alone 
 Corrected missing animation on certain (mirrored) track pieces 
 Added lag compensation for projectiles, so that they are more in sync 
 Fixed profile issue where middle players signing out would cause logic issues 
 Stopped machine gun bullet impact VFX spawning on last target if it misses 
 Fixed some weapon barrels being rotated incorrectly 
 Fixed vehicles sometimes being permanently inflated 
 Fixed vehicles on the start line being jumbled 
 Various crash fixes

notes.title: Make Way Patch 1.1 early opt-in now available
notes.notes:
Hi racers,

A small update to share - today we've rolled out Patch 1.1 on a dedicated beta branch, which introduces the following fixes:

* Fixes the duplicate player bug when playing the game on certain LAN set-ups.
* Fixes the connection issues certain players are experiencing by using the fallback relay server.
* Fixes the shortcut logic not working on clients.
* Fixes the invites not working outside the game on Steam.

We're opening this branch up for everyone to sample ahead of our wider rollout, and you can access it immediately by using the following steps:


 Right click 'Make Way' in your Steam Library and select 'Properties'
 Select 'Betas'
 In the 'Beta Participation' drop-down select 'patch_1.1'
 The update should now download


This branch shouldn't prevent players playing with other platforms, or players on patch 1.0.

notes.title: Make Way on track for December 4 release
notes.notes:
All the pieces are falling into place - the chaotic cross-platform party "DIY racer" Make Way will be charging onto PC on 4 December!

Make Way is a fast-paced thrill-ride with a simple mantra: Build, Race, Win, Repeat. Players must build their own tracks alongside their friends with a set of randomly selected pieces, before battling in round-based races to take the top spot on their ever-expanding courses. With a wide array of obstacles and track pieces to unlock and use, no two races will ever be the same. 

[previewyoutube=O3ms-INT2T8;full][/previewyoutube]
We're incredibly excited to announce that Make Way will be the first game ever to launch as part of Jingle Jam, the annual charity fundraising event that brings influencers, gamers and the games industry together to raise millions for charity. Jingle Jam has raised over £23m for good causes since 2011. Available from 1 December, the Jingle Jam 2023 bundle Games Collection will include more than 70 games worth an incredible £1,000, with 100% of proceeds shared between 12 charities. Steam keys for Make Way bought as part of the Jingle Jam games collection will activate on 4 December.

About Make Way:

 Mix and match unique track pieces and hazards for near-endless course configurations 
 Fight for weapons and power-ups to gain the advantage 
 Unlock new track pieces and vehicles for wackier races 
 Up to four players, either locally or online with cross-platform multiplayer 
 Adjust the chaos levels with customisable rules, giving you control over safety barriers, hazard placement, and more 

Make Way will launch on PC via Steam on 4 December 2023 for $14.99 / £12.99 / €14.99, with consoles coming soon. The Steam version will be available as part of Jingle Jam from 1 December.
